gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha has tall lowercase and wide curves. Revalia's loose, widely spaced display letters sit above it with a bold swagger, while the body keeps its footing quietly beneath.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Revalia's g, with its open lower curve, gives the heading a relaxed, showy swing. Noto Sans Limbu follows with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves, so a long passage feels approachable and modern.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu keeps its ascender tops nearly touching the x-height line, and its s curves open wide. Over a long passage it reads smoothly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-lydian: That relaxed stride across widely separated letters is pure Revalia. Noto Sans Lydian keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase and its openings wide, so the loud heading and the approachable sans feel like loose, friendly neighbors.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Loud, loose and a bit theatrical. Noto Sans Mahajani brings the steadiness, a plain sans with lowercase standing tall against its capitals and a funnel-wide throat in the e.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Revalia swaggers in, bold and widely spaced. Noto Sans Malayalam lets the middle zone of each line dominate, and its generous s bends keep a long passage easy to move through.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic has lowercase rising close to its capitals and curvy, unclamped letters. Noto Sans Mandaic gives Revalia's bold, expressive heading a body that feels loose-limbed without ever shouting.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Big, loose display letters with an open-curved g, stretched across the line with a showy ease. Noto Sans Marchen answers with near-capital small letters and daylight at every curve.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numera: Revalia stretches its bold letters out in a relaxed stride. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals backs that up with tall-bodied small letters and a plain sans c that gapes at any size, giving the heading a roomy partner.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Revalia opens with a tall band of letters and short stalks above, loud and loosely spaced. Noto Sans Medefaidrin rises high in the lowercase and leaves no ink pooling where curves turn, a modern plain sans partner.
